description: This file defines and implements classes and functions related to plugin metadata, including enums, data structures, and JSON serialization for plugin states, channels, services, and subsystems within the WPEFramework. It also includes external file references and methods for handling plugin states and network types.

classes.name: MetaData::Service
classes.description: Represents plugin service metadata, including state, module info, version, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel
classes.description: Represents communication channel metadata with remote info, state, activity, ID, and name.

classes.name: MetaData::Bridge
classes.description: Represents bridge connection details such as locator, latency, model, and security.

classes.name: MetaData::Server
classes.description: Contains server statistics like thread pool size, pending requests, and occupation.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Main container class aggregating plugins, channels, server info, bridges, values, and subsystems.

classes.name: SubSystem
classes.description: Manages subsystem availability states, allowing addition and JSON serialization.

methods.name: MetaData::Service::operator=(const PluginHost::IShell*)
methods.description: Assigns the service state based on the shell's state and possibly its IStateControl interface.

methods.name: MetaData::Service::Data()
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the service's state.

methods.name: MetaData::Channel::operator=(const MetaData::Channel&)
methods.description: Copies channel properties from another instance.

methods.name: MetaData::Channel::Data()
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the channel's state.

methods.name: MetaData::Bridge::Bridge(const string&, uint32_t, const string&, bool)
methods.description: Initializes a bridge object with locator, latency, model, and security flag.

methods.name: MetaData::SubSystem::Add(PluginHost::ISubSystem::subsystem, bool)
methods.description: Adds a subsystem with its availability status to the internal map and JSON structure.
